title: Skip intro
note: It's Always Sunny S1 E1 at 1:47. The intro runs 1:44 to 2:11 (TheIntroDB). The chip stays 10 s; OK skips to 2:11. The hint bar shows the first 5 times.

title: Skip intro in the button row
note: The controls are up during the intro (▲ pressed at 1:52). The floating chip moves into the row, after Next episode so nothing else moves, and ▲ lands on it. When the intro ends the pill goes and focus returns to the seek thumb.

title: After a skip: the way back
note: After every skip, pressed or by itself. S1 E2's 27 s intro (1:18.9 to 1:45.9) was skipped; for 5 s of playing time from the first frame after the jump, OK goes back to its start (the key cap is dimmed for the first 0.5 s). The two-line subtitle would touch the chip, so it steps up to 8 above it.

title: Back to intro, with the controls up
note: He paused 2 s after the skip. The way-back chip's life stops; the row has Back to intro in the Skip pill's place; focus stays on the seek thumb (OK plays). When the controls hide, the chip comes back with the 3 s it had left.

title: Skip recap
note: Lost S2 E1 at 0:06, the first episode he has watched in weeks, so the recap (0:02 to 0:28) gets the button; after S1 E24 last night it would skip by itself, with the way-back chip. Recaps have speech; this short line does not touch the chip, so it stays where it is. After 5 views the hint bar stops; the key cap on the chip says what OK does.

title: Up next when the credits start
note: The credits start at 21:28 (TheIntroDB, passed the checks) and no one speaks after it. Up next comes after 1.5 s without a key, counts 15 s and plays the next one. OK plays now (after 0.7 s); Back stops the count and keeps the queue.

title: Intros in this show
note: OK on the Options row. Same as Account (the default) follows Account; a choice made here wins over it; Account's Off wins over everything. Recaps follow their own rule (foot).

title: The offer: this show by itself
note: After his Skip intro press in a second episode of the show, 10 s after the way-back chip went (never in an intro). 8 s of playing time. OK yes; Back not now (like letting it run out: asked once more, then never). The explicit No is in ▼ Options.

title: Options in an episode
note: ▼ in an episode. Intros in this show is the last row (episodes only), with this show's value (Same as Account until he picks one). The panel keeps the films' 384 width.
